name: zzAL2_pose_mission

tests.name: the mission subsystem that is on screen was found

detail.note: found by asking which instance is drawing rather than by taking the first: a stale subsystem from an earlier PIE session answers every call and drives nothing.

tests.name: Relay OG was put back on the Dog, and it went back
every skin produced a costume and started the fixture
the Dog performed more than one act across the fixture

detail.note: THE CONTROL. A fixture that does not drive the Dog leaves one act for the whole run, and every skin then agrees with the canon body about a pose that never changed. The first pose run passed exactly that way on a Dog that was standing still.

tests.name: the canonical pose actually moved during the mission

detail.note: the second control: the acts can change while the pose stays put, and a comparison of two unchanging structs is not a measurement.

tests.name: every costume wears the canonical pose through the whole mission

detail.note: the founder's 'same for Mission Contract: start, planning, implementing, verifying, completion, props, return to idle'. Whether each act LOOKS right is theirs to judge; this says whether the costume is driven by the same numbers as the canon body throughout.
